title: Executive Order 14387: Promoting the National Defense by Ensuring an Adequate Supply of Elemental Phosphorus and Glypho…
summary: Executive Order 14387, "Promoting the National Defense by Ensuring an Adequate Supply of Elemental Phosphorus and Glyphosate- Based Herbicides", was signed on 2026-02-18 and published in the Federal Register on 2026-02-23 (91 FR 8703).
